:::{#exm-mvn-bivariate}
#### A bivariate Gaussian density

Let $p = 2$, $\vecf{\mean} = \vzero$, and
$\matr{\covmat} = \pmat{1 & 0.8 \\ 0.8 & 1}$.
Then $\det(\matr{\covmat}) = 1 - 0.8^2 = 0.36$,
so the [density](random-variables.qmd#def-pdf)
of $\vX \sim \Normal_2\paren{\vzero, \matr{\covmat}}$ ([multivariate Gaussian](#def-mvn))
at the [mean](expectation.qmd#def-expectation),
which is also its peak,
is:

$$
\ba
\pf{\vzero}
&= \frac{1}{2\pi \cd 0.36^{1/2}}
\ef{0}
&& \text{(substitute into the multivariate normal density)} \\
&= \frac{1}{0.6 \cd 2\pi}
&& \text{(simplify)}
\ea
$$

which is about
`r round(1 / (0.6 * 2 * pi), 3)`.
The density is a bell-shaped surface over the $(x_1, x_2)$ plane (@fig-mvn-bivariate-3d).
Because $\matr{\covmat}_{12} = 0.8 > 0$,
the surface is stretched along the line $x_2 = x_1$.

{{< include pds/_subfiles/_fig-mvn-bivariate-3d.qmd >}}

:::
